notes.title: NOMANUAL V1.1.0 Update
notes.content:
[h2]📌 Major Updates [/h2]

Thank you to everyone who plays NOMANUAL.
This update includes improvements in graphic quality and convenience.

In particular, the brightness and graphic quality of the map have been improved by reflecting feedback on lighting.

In addition, visibility for finding items has been improved to enable intuitive gameplay.

We will continue to create a more complete NOMANUAL. Thank you.

[h2]📌 Bug Fixes and Improvements [/h2]
[list]
[*] In-game option UI translation omission issue fixed
[*] Translation omission of handover rules and some page bug fixes
[*] Ending-related item guide UI provided
[/list]

[h3]Hospital stage[/h3]
[list]
[*] Doctor and nurse dialogue translation fixed
[/list]
[h3]Hotel tutorial stage[/h3]
[list]
[*] Stamina recovery bug fixed
[*] Some doors can be passed through bug fixed
[*] Report app translation omission bug fixed when working on a computer
[/list]

notes.title: NOMANUAL 1.0.0 Release
notes.content:
[h1]📌 Major Update [/h1]

Thank you to everyone for playing NOMANUAL.
[b]As of February 15, 2025, NOMANUAL's early access period has ended.[/b]

This update focuses on overall quality-of-life improvements and game balance adjustments.

Notably, [u]English and Japanese translations have been completed[/u], ensuring a smoother gameplay experience.
Additionally, the manual has been completely overhauled, making gameplay more intuitive.

Various fixes have also been implemented to enhance player interaction and overall immersion.

We will continue refining NOMANUAL to provide the best possible experience. Thank you!


[h3]📌 Details [/h3]
✅ Major Updates

- English and Japanese localization completed
- Manual completely revamped

Below is an example of the added design effects:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45327607/11bd32982bc4a5019330cfb022244c2cbe2d7046.png[/img]

✅ Important Fixes

- Increased flashlight brightness
- Increased stamina recovery speed
- Increased player interaction range
- Significantly increased healing item effectiveness
- Removal of obstacles inside the hotel

✅ Other Fixes

- Fixed a bug where the logic of some abnormalities did not work
- Fixed a bug where some abnormal phenomenon animations did not play 
- Fixed bug where modeling of some abnormalities did not appear

notes.title: NOMANUAL 2.0.1 Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45327607/e4aed7a9fc5dce154d9f13c2fae154ebb7118a21.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45327607/110dcff2842c89e5b1a5681d5677e0fe9a6b9580.png[/img]

[h3]January 15, 2025, the game is finally officially released.
[/h3]

First of all, I would like to express my sincere gratitude to everyone who has been waiting.

This update adds [b]two new endings[/b].

Please read the rulebook carefully. There are hints hidden there.

We have also patched minor bugs from previous feedback.

We will continue to develop NOMANUAL through continuous updates and improvements.

Thank you.

[list]
[*] Detail

[list]
[*] Multi-endings (2 volumes) have been added.
[*] Some abnormal bugs have been fixed.
[*] The problem of the toilet in the guest room bathroom has been fixed.
[*] The problem of the hospital map object being stuck has been fixed.
[/list]
[/list]

⚠️ The current version still has some English and Japanese translations missing. 
　　This may cause some problems when playing.
